input.title: Garden bed dimensions and planting (9:06 PM)
input.body:
- Build a 4x8 raised bed this weekend.
- Use cedar boards about 12 inches tall.
- Need roughly 32 cubic feet of soil.
- Plant tomatoes and basil.
- Buy materials on Saturday.
- Place bed on south side for maximum sun.
